answers.explanation: ShareLinkViewSet explicitly uses permission_classes=(IsAuthenticated, PaperlessObjectPermissions). IsAuthenticated controls whether the request has an authenticated principal. No authentication_classes override is visible on ShareLinkViewSet, so authentication backends are inherited from DRF/application settings and were not established here. The accepted semantics also do not prove an object-permission invocation against the requested document during create.
